question.html:
An electric motor of resistance is connected to a cell of emf V. The internal resistance of the cell is not negligible.

a. Explain why the emf of the cell and the potential difference across the electric motor are different.

   [2]

A second, identical motor is connected to the cell in series with the first motor. The power dissipated in one of the motors is W.

b. Show that the current in the cell is about A.

   [2]

c. Find the power dissipated in the cell. Give your answer to an appropriate number of significant figures.
